reviewers.scope: draft sections 0-25: spinors and Clifford algebra
draft sections 26-39: superspace, chiral fields, projections
draft sections 40-54: gauge superfields and actions

resolved_findings.finding: Weinberg unnormalized antisymmetrization was treated as normalized.
resolved_findings.resolution: Introduced normalized Gamma products and retained Weinberg brackets with factors r!.

resolved_findings.finding: The Majorana Fierz formula was presented as convention-independent.
resolved_findings.resolution: Derived and exact-checked separate Weinberg and Srednicki indexed identities.

resolved_findings.finding: Noether charges, coordinate differential generators, and Srednicki differential operators were conflated.
resolved_findings.resolution: Separated all three representation surfaces and verified their operator maps on the full exterior basis.

resolved_findings.finding: The pointwise D-projection rule omitted the Weinberg Box C term.
resolved_findings.resolution: Replaced it by [X]^S_D=1/2 [X]^W_D+1/4 Box C_X and restricted the factor-two rule to the integrated action with a vanishing boundary term.

resolved_findings.finding: Weinberg canonical and rescaled gauge bases were merged.
resolved_findings.resolution: Separated (t_A,V_c,Omega_c) from (T_A,Vhat,Omegahat) and derived both maps.

resolved_findings.finding: The draft Weinberg nonabelian field-strength definition omitted 2t_A and used incorrect exponentials.
resolved_findings.resolution: Marked draft section 48 FALSE and inserted Weinberg equation 27.3.13 with its Abelian limit.

resolved_findings.finding: Cross-book Majorana and superspace phases were stated as unique.
resolved_findings.resolution: Retained s=plus-or-minus-one branch freedom and declared the working component/coordinate pair jointly.

resolved_findings.finding: Generic real-scalar D projections and chiral F projections leaked into one domain.
resolved_findings.resolution: Separated paired-real and paired-left-chiral statements and their source anchors.

resolved_findings.finding: Integrated-by-parts kinetic expressions were labelled as local coefficients.
resolved_findings.resolution: Displayed both exact local coefficients and integrated formulas with the boundary hypothesis.

resolved_findings.finding: Derived four-component Srednicki packages were over-attributed to the author.
resolved_findings.resolution: Labelled package assembly and phase equations as dictionary derivations; retained only direct coordinate and matrix claims as author statements.

resolved_findings.finding: The exact verifier used coefficient tautologies for superspace operators.
resolved_findings.resolution: Independently constructed Srednicki operators and checked all Q, D, brackets, and chiral coordinates on all 16 odd monomials.
